evidence_quotes.quote: Video_Clip_QA accepts windows up to 90 seconds, but the requested window is 485.17 seconds. Use Semantic_Retrieve or Segment_Retrieve to localize relevant evidence, then inspect one focused window.

issues.proposed_fix: Modify the planner's pre-execution validation to automatically split any query exceeding 90 seconds into overlapping 90-second windows before invoking Video_Clip_QA, or switch to a tool capable of full-video analysis if available.
